title: El Sistema Nacional de Información Sanitaria de Guinea Ecuatorial mejora 22,5 puntos y pasa a nivel "satisfactorio"
why_not: Reports the SIS evaluation score rising from 34.8% (2014) to 57.3% (2025), presented 18 August 2026; states nothing on tiers, the one HMIS gap. The only aspects it touches (last12, governance) are already held.
